title: Assembly required, not enough for an entire room.
text: Assembly required, not enough for an entire room.. That is the entire kit assembled. The colors are nice. I had to build the banner, and punch holes in some of the letters. I also had to tear apart the swirl streamers. It was more to assemble than I anticipated for the price. Wouldn't be enough for a full room.
